description: OCCTO provides a national entry point for power-system information, wide-area reserve margins and unit-level generation publications. It also links supply-demand status and historical records for Japan’s regional operators. The provider is Organization for Cross-regional Coordination of Transmission Operators. Coverage: Coverage is Japan, with separate operator areas and service-specific publication periods. The landing page does not establish a common sampling interval or complete data history. Access: The official service directory identifies live systems, manuals and regional data sources. No files or interactive service sessions were obtained. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Each linked system has separate coverage, terms and operating requirements. The directory does not itself provide one harmonised numerical dataset. For simulation it supplies routes to official operational balances, generation and reserve indicators. Related resources: This national operator-service entry includes routes to regional series, including the separately reviewed TEPCO item.
